description: Delivered 28 May 1970; registered 9 June 1970 as CCCP-87749 to the Moscow Directorate of Special Applications and Local Airlines (from 1971 UGATs) at Bykovo; transferred to the Aktyubinsk Higher Civil Aviation Flying School 17 May 1979; struck off 16 August 1988; later erected as a monument at Stepnyak; year_built from the delivery date as no separate build date is stated
